title: Director of Plant Operations
text:
Lasko is seeking a Director of Plant Operations to lead our manufacturing facility in Franklin, Tennessee. This leader will oversee plant performance, with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee development.
 
 
The Director will translate business priorities into effective operating plans, strengthen manufacturing processes, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Working closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Human Resources, and Finance, this individual will ensure the facility consistently delivers quality products while improving productivity, controlling costs, and supporting Lasko’s growth.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a visible, hands-on leader who builds strong teams, uses data to guide decisions, and maintains a consistent presence on the production floor.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
*Plant Leadership and Operational Performance*

* Lead daily plant operations, coordinating production, maintenance, manufacturing support, and material flow to meet safety, quality, cost, and delivery objectives.
* Develop and execute operating plans that align production capacity, staffing, equipment, and materials with business requirements.
* Establish clear performance expectations and operating metrics; review results regularly and drive corrective actions when performance falls short.
* Partner with Supply Chain and production planning teams to manage schedules, respond to changing demand, and maintain reliable customer service.
* Resolve operational challenges quickly while implementing lasting solutions that prevent recurring issues.

*Safety, Quality, and Compliance*

* Champion a culture in which employee safety is a daily priority and leaders take ownership of safe work practices.
* Oversee plant safety, environmental performance, and facility security in partnership with the appropriate support teams.
* Ensure consistent adherence to company policies, operating procedures, and applicable requirements.
* Partner with Quality and Engineering to improve process controls, reduce defects and rework, and ensure finished products meet established standards.
* Support audits, investigations, and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-through and sustainable improvements

*Continuous Improvement and Manufacturing Excellence*

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase throughput, improve equipment reliability, reduce waste, and strengthen overall plant performance.
* Apply Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis, standard work, and structured problem-solving to improve operating processes.
* Use production, quality, maintenance, and cost data to identify performance gaps and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering to strengthen preventive maintenance programs and address equipment constraints.
* Support new product introductions, process changes, and manufacturing readiness to achieve successful production launches.

*Financial and Resource Management*

* Develop and manage plant operating budgets, monitor spending, and take action to address cost variances.
* Improve labor productivity, material utilization, energy efficiency, and material handling costs while maintaining safety and quality standards.
* Partner with Finance and Supply Chain to strengthen inventory accuracy, control work in process, and support effective inventory management.
* Identify and prioritize capital investment needs; develop business cases for equipment upgrades, automation, and facility improvements.
* Ensure people, equipment, and materials are deployed effectively to meet production commitments.

*People Leadership and Development*

* Build, coach, and develop a strong plant leadership team with clear responsibilities and measurable goals.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, training, performance management, and employee relations.
* Foster a respectful, collaborative environment that encourages employee involvement, open communication, and ownership of results.
* Develop leadership capabilities and succession plans to support long-term operational stability.
* Maintain effective communication across shifts and departments to ensure consistent priorities and execution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including substantial leadership responsibility for plant performance and people management.
* Demonstrated success leading a manufacturing facility or a significant manufacturing operation with responsibility for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee development.
* Strong understanding of production planning, inventory control, equipment maintenance, quality systems, and manufacturing cost drivers.
* Experience developing and managing operating budgets, evaluating capital investments, and improving financial performance.
* Demonstrated ability to lead continuous improvement initiatives and deliver measurable operational results.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance immediate production needs and longer-term priorities.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work across all levels of the organization.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using ERP systems and manufacturing performance data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in consumer products or another high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with injection molding, assembly operations, automation, and related manufacturing processes.
* Experience leading operations across multiple shifts and managing seasonal changes in production demand.
* Lean or Six Sigma training or certification.
* Experience leading organizational change, developing plant leaders, and strengthening employee engagement.

*Work Environment*
This position is based onsite at Lasko’s Franklin, TN manufacturing facility and requires regular presence on the production floor. Flexibility is required to support plant operations across shifts and address business needs.
 
 
**About Lasko Products**
***Love Your Air*
™**
Lasko Products is the leading air solutions brand with a reputation for reliable products, peak performance, and perpetual innovation – our commitment to our customers for over a century. Founded in 1906 by Henry Lasko in Philadelphia, Lasko has evolved for over a century to become the global leader in air solution products. From our roots in small appliances, fans, and portable heaters, we’ve grown to become the leading home comfort company while maintaining our unwavering commitment to quality and value. Today, Lasko stands as a symbol of innovation, offering consumers around the world high-performance products; portable fans, heaters, air purifiers, humidifiers, and home ventilation solutions. Our well-known brands, Lasko, B-Air, BlueDri, Air King, and Guardian Technologies, serve both consumer and commercial markets across North America and internationally. As an American company for 120 years, we take pride in upholding the spirit of hard work, trust and accessibility, ensuring that Lasko remains available to all, for generations to come. Headquartered in West Chester, Pennsylvania, with manufacturing and distribution facilities in Tennessee and Texas, Lasko intends to set the standard in the air solutions category for another 100 years.
 
 
***Lasko’s mission is to provide comfort you can trust.***
Our company’s success is based on our culture of
**GRACE**
, with five core “
*Be*
” values outlining how we live it.
 
 
**Growth Mindset —**
*Be Bold*

* We are never the finished product ─ every failure is a data point, every setback is a setup.

**Recognition —**
*Be Together*


* We win together. We celebrate together! High performance deserves to be seen ─ named, specific, remembered.

**Authenticity —**
*Be Real*

* No masks. No politics. Show up as you are, say what you mean, and mean what you say.

**Clear Communication —**
*Be Clear*

* Say it plainly. Say it once. Say it to the right person. Clarity is kindness.

**Extreme Ownership —**
Be
*Accountable*


* No blame. No excuses. Own the win and the loss. No exceptions.

**Why Join Lasko?**
At Lasko, we believe people do their best work when they’re supported ─ personally and professionally. That’s why we offer flexible hours and a hybrid work schedule for our corporate team, promoting employees to balance life and work in a way that fits their lifestyle. Our dog-friendly corporate headquarters adds a fun, welcoming atmosphere, while our competitive salaries with bonus potential recognize and reward your contributions. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes a strong 401(k) match, wellness incentives, and robust health coverage. Join Lasko and be part of a legacy of innovation – at a company that values flexibility, growth, and a culture where you can thrive.
